title: Monitor Amazon Aurora DSQL costs with the Aurora DSQL console and CloudWatch alarms
text: As your Amazon Aurora DSQL workload scales, DPU consumption and storage costs can grow without a fixed instance ceiling. This post shows how to monitor Aurora DSQL usage and cost with the built-in Usage and cost panel, set up Amazon CloudWatch alarms for hourly DPU spend, and deploy the alarms as code with AWS CloudFormation.
